title: Plutus Flow Cheatsheet
tweets:
Plutus Flow Cheatsheet ⚖️

📈 Flow rising + Price rising = Trend confirmed
📈 Flow rising + Price falling = Possible accumulation
📉 Flow falling + Price rising = Possible distribution
📉 Flow falling + Price falling = Downtrend confirmed

Divergence is the signal. 🧵

The key insight:

When flow and price AGREE → the trend has conviction.
When they DISAGREE → something is shifting beneath the surface.

Divergence = early warning. It doesn't mean reversal is instant — it means the current move may be losing steam.

title: 📚 DOCS: PLUTUS FLOW DIVERGENCE GUIDE
tweets: Plutus Flow divergence guide 🧵

BULLISH DIVERGENCE:
◾ Price makes lower low
◾ Plutus Flow makes higher low
◾ = Selling pressure weakening

BEARISH DIVERGENCE:
◾ Price makes higher high
◾ Plutus Flow makes lower high
◾ = Buying pressure weakening

Divergence = Flow disagrees with price.
It's a WARNING, not an entry. Wait for structure confirmation.

When The Scales tips, pay attention.

🔗 Try Plutus Flow: https://www.tradingview.com/script/uoZjVlZA-Plutus-Flow-Statistical-OBV-Analysis/
